name: micropython-lsp
description: Autocomplete, type checking and inline docs for MicroPython and CircuitPython. Work on VSCode web in the browser.

micropython-lsp.enable.description: Enable or disable the MicroPython/CircuitPython language server. Turn this off for a project where you would rather use a general Python language server.

micropython-lsp.logLevel.description: How much the bundled language server itself logs. Different levels are useful for debugging.

micropython-lsp.debug.description: Developer/debugging setting. Mirror language server logs to the developer console, including worker boot and background-worker relay activity. The output channel always records them; this makes them visible in DevTools and in headless test runs.

micropython-lsp.trace.server.description: Developer/debugging setting. Trace LSP traffic between VS Code and the Python language server. 'verbose' includes message bodies. Combine with micropython-lsp.debug to see it in the console.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test-web --headless --extensionDevelopmentPath=. --extensionTestsPath=./test/integration/dist/index.js ./test/workspace
